meta.title: sunnysays: a little sunflower that lives in your menu bar
meta.description: Sunny is a sunflower in a pot that lives in your Mac's menu bar and says something about once an hour. Quiet during calls. No network. Free.
meta.ogTitle: sunnysays: a little sunflower that talks
meta.ogDescription: Sunny lives in your menu bar, says something now and then, and keeps quiet during calls. Free for Mac.
meta.ogImageAlt: Sunny, a smiling sunflower in a terracotta pot, next to a speech bubble.

og.subtitle: Lives in your Mac's menu bar. Quiet during calls.

a11y.sunny: Sunny, a sunflower in a pot. Press it to hear a line.

store.mac: Download on the Mac App Store

hero.title: A little sunflower that says things.
hero.lede: It lives in your Mac's menu bar, says a line now and then, and knows when to hush. Give it a day below.

desk.ariaLabel: A little Mac screen with Sunny's panel open from the menu bar

promise.title: Polite, private, free.
promise.body: Every feature is free. Tips go through the App Store, unlock nothing, and just say thanks.

get.title: Give Sunny a spot by your window.
get.lede: It's small, it's polite, and it's happy to see you.

notFound.title: Nothing grows here.
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist. Sunny looked everywhere. Well, everywhere it can see from the pot.

rules.start: Tap anything below. Sunny follows the same rules as on your Mac.
rules.poke: Press it any time. On your Mac it also speaks up on its own, about once an hour.
rules.shushedPoke: Shushed. Press Wake up to hear it again.
rules.shh: Shh: for an hour, the rest of today, or until you say.
rules.wake: It wakes up with one line.
rules.callCut: A call started, so it stopped mid-word.
rules.call: On a call it keeps quiet.
rules.callOver: Call's over: one quiet line, then back to normal.
rules.callOverQuiet: Call's over. It's still keeping quiet.
rules.full: Full screen: it waits until you're back.
rules.fullOff: Out of full screen. It never talked over your slides.
rules.away: Away or locked: it won't talk to an empty room.
rules.back: You're back. One line, then it lets you work.
rules.backQuiet: You're back, but it's still keeping quiet.
rules.battery: It notices the little things, like a low battery.
rules.batteryQuiet: It noticed the battery. It'll keep that to itself.
rules.dark: Dark mode: it notices that too.
rules.night: Late at night it says so, gently. You pick its hours.
